list.title: Roles

create.title: Create Role
create.subtitle: Define a new role's identity, base type, and granted permissions.
create.reasonRequired: A reason is required to create a role.
create.baseTypeInfo: New roles are currently based on one of the built-in types for compatibility with parts of the system not yet migrated to the new permission model. Permissions marked "Enforced" in the next step apply fully; everything else follows <role>{{role}}</role>'s existing behavior.
create.startingPoint: Starting point: {{role}}'s current permissions (edit freely below)
create.cloneIntro: Or clone permissions from any existing role:
create.signatureMeaning: I am creating the role "{{name}}" and granting it {{count}} permission(s). Reason: {{reason}}

detail.title: Role
detail.subtitle: Edit this role's name, description, and granted permissions.
detail.reasonRequired: A reason is required to save changes to a role.
detail.name: Name
detail.sodWarning: This role mixes system administration with GxP execution or approval ({{conflicts}}). Segregation of duties does not allow that: uncheck one side of each pair and save.
detail.customInfo: This role behaves like <type>{{type}}</type> on screens not yet migrated to the new permission system (marked "Legacy-only" below). Custom permissions take full effect on everything marked "Enforced".
detail.usersLoadFailed: The users holding this role could not be loaded.
detail.noUsers: No users currently hold this role.
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete role "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
detail.deleteAssigned: It is currently assigned to {{count}} user(s) and cannot be deleted until they are reassigned.
detail.permissionsMeaning: I am changing the permissions of the role "{{name}}". Reason: {{reason}}
detail.deleteMeaning: I am deleting the role "{{name}}". Reason: {{reason}}

matrix.qaForbidden: Not available to a Quality Assurance role
matrix.cannotCombine: Cannot be combined with {{code}}: a role may not hold both system administration and GxP execution or approval.
matrix.enforcedTip: This permission alone controls access - the endpoints it covers check it directly.
matrix.legacyTip: Access on screens covered by this permission still follows the role's underlying base type, not this checkbox, until that screen is migrated to the new permission system.
